text.text_excerpt: This is a great locally owned neighborhood bakery. I love their mixed berry brioche and iced coffee. They have a great selection of pastries. They also have great quiches and premade sandwiches, but they run out by early afternoon. They close at 3, but are open early in the morning for breakfast. I like to walk their on saturday morning and eat my breakfast and coffee outside on a pretty day, or inside in the quaint bakery. The owner and staff are very friendly. They are cash or check only. I've heard their fresh made bagles are amazing.

Darling little place around the corner from Whole Foods Uptown. They have a nice variety of breads and sweets and everything is special and made with care. This is also the only bakery in NOLA that has real bagels, which earns them the 5th star. Be warned: they have a rule about how many you can buy. I'm serious. You can only buy 4 at time, otherwise you need a special order. They are really really good though. They have daily special sandwiches and cupcakes so there's always something new. It's a beautiful old building and the employees are friendly. Highly recommended. Cash or local check only.

A fantastic local bakery in Uptown, in a residential neighborhood just before Jefferson. It's got a great atmosphere to go and eat breakfast and read a paper or a book. This place makes *the* best croissants and bagels in the city. I can't say much more than that. Go try them--done to perfection. I've had the brownies and cookies before and I think they are excellent, too. I like their coffee as well. As a plus, it's very close to the other great bakery in New Orleans, La Boulangerie...but I think they are a good complement to each other. Stop at La Boulangerie for your bread and Laurel St for croissants, pastries, and bagels.
